vb_textbox.text: my advice for the participant is that he should be careful in moving close to certain gnome so as not to get implicated and be unable to harvest a good amount of mushroom. Using the S and the K key, one can navigate the gnome which you want. I will advise you pick the gnome on the right hand side using key K as this gnome leads you to the forest that will give you more number of mushrooms to harvest. Based on my personal experience, the gnome on the left hand side or the gnome with green hat mostly give me a higher number of mushrooms to harvest.
